mc_hint.en-us: Each box is one slot of the material byte: row head + column head. A lit sphere is an assigned material - wearing its promoted bundle's maps when the package holds one, else a flat finish in its index colour; an empty box is a free slot; the last eight are the emissive slots, which hold emissive materials only. Press a box to inspect it. To make or bind a material, use the MaterialBench.

insp_note_invalid.en-us: The bundle's recipe does not load - its graph cannot be shown (the log names why).

insp_note_incomplete.en-us: The bundle holds its recipe but not all seven maps - the sample wears the index colour until it is baked whole.

insp_graph_none.en-us: No graph - this slot has no bundle.

insp_graph_invalid.en-us: No graph - the bundle's recipe does not load.

cat_rec_prop_note.en-us: text + text_field, select or stepper. A property sheet is a stack of these.

cat_rec_tree_note.en-us: caret button + name button. The depth is an arrange bind on the row, not a nest of containers.

cat_rec_crumb_note.en-us: row + rows_from over one button prototype. The path is data, so a deeper path is more rows.

cat_rec_notice_body.en-us: This cluster changed after the last bake. Re-bake before shipping it.

cat_rec_notice_note.en-us: A severity panel over a glyph and its copy. The severity is a colour token.

cat_rec_tp_note.en-us: Three verbs and a readout. Every timeline consumer wears this bar.

cat_rec_res_note.en-us: resource_gauge + text. A readout strip is a row of these.

cat_rec_cmd_note.en-us: A grid of action_slot. The hotbar and the command card are one arrangement at two densities.

cat_rec_collapse_body.en-us: The body is an ordinary cell behind a visible_bind the header flips.

cat_rec_collapse_note.en-us: header button + visible_bind cell. No collapsible prop was promoted.

cat_rec_drop_note.en-us: drag_kind on the source, drop_accept and drop_action on the target. Pointer release and pad confirm both land here.

cat_fill_plot_note.en-us: One demo series read three ways, drawn as line primitives inside the seated rect.

cat_fill_graph_note.en-us: Three demo nodes and one self-loop. Drag a card, wheel to zoom, middle-drag to pan.

cat_fill_timeline_note.en-us: Seven lanes of span and point events under a moving playhead. Wheel zooms about the cursor.

cat_fill_gadget_note.en-us: The reusable manipulation overlay in translate mode. Aim, locked and modifying each colour the handle.

cat_fill_doll_note.en-us: The small-panel rig preview on its authored stage. No rig is uploaded here, so the ground ring is what draws.

cat_modal_note.en-us: Each button opens the shared tree by id; the answer returns through the scene's modal-closed hook. Busy refuses Escape mid-work and allows it at done.

cat_modal_demo_body.en-us: The catalog opened this shared tree with demo params, and prints whatever it answers.

cat_modal_busy_body.en-us: A demo job runs for about two seconds. Escape is refused while it works, honoured once the bar is full — wait and it closes itself with done.

cat_modal_prompt_body.en-us: The shared text prompt, seeded with demo text.
